Each vehicle type has a daily inventory limit, provided in ‚Äúcapacity.csv.‚Äù The objective is to decide how many units of each vehicle type to order each day so as to maximize total benefit while ensuring that the sum of all ordered units does not exceed the total inventory capacity. x_i ∈ ℤ≥0  for all i ∈ I

Constraints:

  x_i ≤ u_i  for all i ∈ I

  ∑_{i∈I} x_i ≤ ∑_{i∈I} u_i

import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

def solve_problem(CSVQA_FRAMES):
    cap_frame = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_0_view_0']
    prod_frame = CSVQA_FRAMES['file_1_view_0']
    vehicle_types_cap = set()
    cap_dict = {}
    for (_, row) in cap_frame.iterrows():
        vt = row['VehicleType']
        vehicle_types_cap.add(vt)
        cap_dict[vt] = float(row['Capacity'])
    vehicle_types_prod = set()
    benefit_dict = {}
    for (_, row) in prod_frame.iterrows():
        pn = row['ProductName']
        vehicle_types_prod.add(pn)
        benefit_dict[pn] = float(row['Value'])
    I = sorted(vehicle_types_cap & vehicle_types_prod)
    if len(I) == 0:
        raise ValueError('No matching vehicle types between capacity.csv and products.csv.')
    b_i = {i: benefit_dict[i] for i in I}
    u_i = {i: cap_dict[i] for i in I}
    m = gp.Model('vehicle_inventory_optimization')
    quantity_vars = m.addVars(I, lb=0, ub=[u_i[i] for i in I], vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name='')
    m.setObjective(gp.quicksum((b_i[i] * quantity_vars[i] for i in I)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)
    m.addConstr(gp.quicksum((quantity_vars[i] for i in I)) <= sum((u_i[i] for i in I)), name='total_inventory_capacity')
    m.Params.MIPGap = 0.0001
    m.optimize()
    if m.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
        print(f'ObjVal: {m.ObjVal}')
        for v in m.getVars():
            print(f'{v.VarName}: {v.X}')
    else:
        print(f'Solver status: {m.Status}')
    return m
